purpose.en: Connect index laws, exponential graphs, equations and compound growth.
purpose.zh-Hant: 連結指數定律、指數圖像、指數方程和複合增長。

prerequisites.en: Integer powers, roots and solving linear and quadratic equations.
prerequisites.zh-Hant: 整數指數、根式、一次及二次方程。

scopeNote.en: This guide covers the exponential part of the chapter.
scopeNote.zh-Hant: 本導讀涵蓋本章的指數部分。

intro.en: Rewrite roots as fractional powers for positive bases. Factor out the common power when terms are added or subtracted.
intro.zh-Hant: 正底數的根式可寫成分數指數。遇到同底冪相加或相減，先提出公因冪。

trigger.en: Recognise powers of the same base.

trap.en: Adding powers does not mean adding their exponents.
trap.zh-Hant: 同底冪相加時，不可直接相加指數。

intro.en: At zero, a positive base raised to the power zero gives 1. To compare negative exponential graphs, read at x = 1 and reverse the order when changing signs.
intro.zh-Hant: 正底數的零次冪等於 1。比較負指數曲線時，可讀取橫坐標為 1 的縱坐標，變號後須反轉大小次序。

trigger.en: Use a common x-coordinate or read a reciprocal as a negative power.
trigger.zh-Hant: 使用同一橫坐標，或把倒數寫成負指數。

trap.en: A reciprocal does not mean reflecting across the horizontal axis.
trap.zh-Hant: 取倒數並不是把圖像沿橫軸反射。

title.en: Choose a common base or substitute

intro.en: Convert to a common positive base other than 1 before equating exponents. A repeated reciprocal power can become a single variable.
intro.zh-Hant: 先化為同一個不等於 1 的正底數，再比較指數。遇到重複出現的倒數冪，可用一個變量代替。

trigger.en: Look for linear equations in the exponents or a quadratic in a repeated power.
trigger.zh-Hant: 留意指數能否化為一次方程，或換元後能否得到二次方程。

trap.en: Check the domain when converting a solution back to the original variable.
trap.zh-Hant: 把換元所得的解代回原變量時，要核對定義域。

intro.en: Each period multiplies the current quantity, so consecutive growth factors multiply.
intro.zh-Hant: 每一期都按當時數量乘上增長倍數，因此連續各期的倍數須相乘。

trigger.en: Identify the period and its multiplier.
trigger.zh-Hant: 先找出增長期及每期倍數。

trap.en: Doubling the time does not usually double the percentage increase.
trap.zh-Hant: 時間加倍，百分增幅通常不會剛好加倍。
